# nlohmann/json

- Version: 3.12.0
- Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json/tree/v3.12.0
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE.MIT`.

`json.hpp` is the unmodified upstream single-header distribution. It is used
only by Common/Configuration/ConfigurationTools.cpp; control-law execution uses typed C++
configuration and does not depend on JSON objects.
